pages.lesson:
LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.6: Attributes of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Attributes of God. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
   In simple words: practise until you can read scriptures on the attributes of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Attributes of God using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Attributes of God in the examples.
2. Explain Attributes of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Attributes of God.
4. Show that you can: read scriptures on the attributes of God

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Attributes of God using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Attributes of God important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, picture-read 1 John 4:7-8, Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns,
2. Self-Efficacy: the skill of expressing their needs clearly for help is nurtured as they say whom to report to if they are touched inappropriately or sexually abused.
3. Unity is nurtured as they work in groups and sing a song about the love of God. Links to other Learning Areas:
4. English: writing skills are applied as learners write a poem.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
